mission_defs.name: Data Recovery Sweep
mission_defs.description: The reconstruction zone still hums with abandoned GL!TCH-BIO terminals. Somewhere in the static noise lies Dr. Vape’s earliest calibration logs. Send a PERP to sift through corrupted consoles, extract viable residue, and avoid triggering automated clean-up drones. They’re not supposed to touch anything important. They’re absolutely going to touch everything.
